Flow.description: DIR-869 DOA-Routed Discount Approval. Auto-submits when a Quote in Negotiating has Discount changed ( > 0 ). Sets Pending Approval, notifies the manager (bell + email), routes: Discount <= 10% -> Sales Manager only; > 10% -> Sales Manager then RES_Finance_Team queue. Branches on the queried ApprovalWorkItem status (orchestration can't gate on an approval step's approvalDecision output). Final approve -> Approved; any reject -> Rejected + notify initiator; Recall -> Negotiating.

formulas.name: fApprovedBody
formulas.expression: "Your discount request on Quote '" & {!$Record.Name} & "' (" & {!$Record.QuoteNumber} & ") - " & TEXT({!$Record.Discount}) & "% (Amount " & TEXT(({!$Record.Subtotal} - {!$Record.GrandTotal})) & ") - has been approved."

formulas.name: fApproverBody
formulas.expression: "Quote '" & {!$Record.Name} & "' (" & {!$Record.QuoteNumber} & ") needs your approval. Discount " & TEXT({!$Record.Discount}) & "% (Amount " & TEXT(({!$Record.Subtotal} - {!$Record.GrandTotal})) & "). Submitted by " & {!$Record.CreatedBy.FirstName} & " " & {!$Record.CreatedBy.LastName} & "."

formulas.name: fRejectBody
formulas.expression: "Your discount request on Quote '" & {!$Record.Name} & "' (" & {!$Record.QuoteNumber} & ") - " & TEXT({!$Record.Discount}) & "% (Amount " & TEXT(({!$Record.Subtotal} - {!$Record.GrandTotal})) & ") - was rejected. The Quote has been set to Rejected; please revise and resubmit."

formulas.name: fStage1Bell
formulas.expression: "Sales Manager approved Quote " & {!$Record.QuoteNumber} & " (" & TEXT({!$Record.Discount}) & "%). Routed to Finance for final approval."

formulas.name: fWorkItemDesc
formulas.expression: "Discount approval requested - " & TEXT({!$Record.Discount}) & "% (Amount " & TEXT(({!$Record.Subtotal} - {!$Record.GrandTotal})) & ") on Quote " & {!$Record.QuoteNumber} & "."

Flow.label: RES Quote Discount DOA Approval Flow

value.stringValue: approved by the Sales Manager and routed to Finance for final approval
